item.title: Inside Chevron’s flagship refinery tapping into Venezuelan crude after Maduro's capture
item.description: Chevron begins processing Venezuelan oil at Gulf Coast refinery following Maduro's capture, marking the company's first public acknowledgment of operations.

item.title: Stellantis issues 'do not drive' warning for 225,000 vehicles over dangerous air bag issue
item.description: Stellantis issued an urgent stop-drive order for 225,000 vehicles with potentially defective Takata air bags that can explode, sending metal fragments into the cabin.

item.title: US debt set to crush World War II record as annual deficits explode to $3T within decade
item.description: The U.S. national debt is set to break a World War II record by 2030, reaching 108% of GDP as the Congressional Budget Office warns of mounting fiscal challenges ahead.

item.title: Spirit Airlines to sell 20 jets, recalls furloughed flight attendants
item.description: Spirit Airlines will recall 500 flight attendants from furloughs while selling 20 Airbus aircraft to address financial struggles during bankruptcy proceedings.

item.title: Francesca's files for bankruptcy, launches closing sales at all locations
item.description: Women's retailer Francesca's launches going-out-of-business sales with discounts up to 40% of all merchandise categories after filing for bankruptcy.

item.title: Elon Musk slams Anthropic AI models as 'misanthropic and evil' in scathing social media post
item.description: Elon Musk accuses Anthropic's AI models of being "misanthropic and evil," claiming the competitor's Claude models exhibit racial and demographic bias.

item.title: Disney loses $170 million with 'Snow White' flop: report
item.description: The Walt Disney Company reportedly lost nearly $170 million on its "Snow White" live-action remake, which was riddled with controversies.

item.title: Inside Trump’s removal of DOJ antitrust chief Gail Slater
item.description: Gail Slater was ousted for failing to zealously pursue Trump's affordability agenda, sources told Fox News Digital.

item.title: Russia shuts down WhatsApp, pushes citizens to state-run app accused of being a 'surveillance' tool
item.description: Russia has blocked WhatsApp, citing the Meta-owned company’s failure to comply with local laws, as Moscow continues its crackdown on foreign tech platforms.

item.title: Enormous ground beef recall issued over deadly E. coli contamination risk across three states
item.description: USDA recalls nearly 23,000 pounds of ground beef over potential E. coli contamination. Products shipped to California, Idaho and Oregon pose health risks.
